concerns.text: FR-001 requires a pilot human manipulation check (≥80% coder agreement that the moral narrative is preserved). No task collects or verifies such human ratings; T003 only performs computational checks (CLIP, RMS, texture). Add a task to run a human validation study and record its results.

FR-003 and contracts/response.schema.yaml / contracts/survey_responses.schema.yaml require logging of salience level, but neither schema includes a `salience_level` field. A single response row cannot conform to both contracts, so the current task cannot satisfy FR-003 or the contracts. Add a task (or adjust schemas) to ensure the response artifact includes the required fields and matches a single contract.

T003 attempts to satisfy both `stimulus.schema.yaml` and `stimuli_manifest.schema.yaml`, but the two contracts are mutually incompatible (different identifiers, field names, and `additionalProperties: false`). Separate tasks are needed: one to produce a stimulus manifest conforming to `stimuli_manifest.schema.yaml` and another to produce individual stimulus variant records conforming to `stimulus.schema.yaml`.

T003 references `config/manipulation.yaml` for versioned parameters, yet no task creates this configuration file. Add a task to generate and version‑control `config/manipulation.yaml` before manipulation runs.

SC-003 requires measuring the family‑wise error rate (FWER) against the nominal alpha level. T006 only applies a correction but does not compute or report the actual FWER. Add a verification task that calculates the FWER and records it.

FR-006 specifies that effect sizes must be calculated using Type III Sums of Squares (or an equivalent method) for the CLMM. T006 only reports odds ratios and confidence intervals. Add a sub‑task that computes Type III sums of squares (or documents an equivalent approach) and includes it in the results artifact.

SC-005’s precision threshold is deferred, but the pipeline expects `config/pre_registration.yaml` (used by T006). No task creates this file, causing a `PreRegistrationError`. Add a task to produce `config/pre_registration.yaml` with the required `precision_threshold` and verification status.

The contract `stimulus_variant.schema.yaml` (typographic/text manipulation) is never referenced by any task, yet it exists in the contracts directory. Either add a task that generates these records (if the study needs them) or remove the orphaned contract to keep the contract set aligned with tasks.

The data model specifies analysis output at `data/processed/results.json`, but T006 writes to `data/results/results.json`. This mismatch means the data‑model element is not covered by any task. Align the task output path with the data‑model or update the model accordingly.

SC-005’s precision threshold is marked `[deferred]` in the spec, but the analysis task must still verify that the CI width meets the pre‑registered threshold. Since no task creates the threshold source, the verification will always fail. Ensure a task creates the threshold source and that T006 reads it.
